scope.launch: Optional boolean chromiumSandbox on the original shared launch schema. Only true requests the pinned Playwright MCP --sandbox option.
scope.default: False or omission preserves upstream arguments; attachment is unchanged. No --no-sandbox option is added.
scope.authority: This configures the browser process only; no work, tool, network or deployment authorization is introduced.
scope.verification: Capability version identifies this adapter; actual operating-system sandbox support must be verified by the deployment.
